project.name: CYI — Electric Purpose
project.objective: Give CYI an intensely vibrant youth identity across its complete web platform.
project.audience: CYI youth, members, volunteers and supporters.
project.governing_idea: Made for more: faith is alive in people, creativity and service.

creative_system.visual_thesis: A midnight festival canvas gives authentic CYI moments a luminous frame.
creative_system.composition: Oversized type balances an asymmetric arched photo collage, followed by distinct light and saturated chapters.
creative_system.typography: Local Barlow Condensed, local Manrope and one Georgia italic accent.
creative_system.motion: Shared pausable carousel and marquee, with reduced-motion support.

assets.description: One original chrome ribbon, no people, logos or text.
assets.notes: Generated with OpenAI image generation, visually inspected and converted to WebP.

assets.description: Original CYI photos reused at the contracted developer’s request.
CYI – Together, 53 seconds. Source homepage and public Vimeo oEmbed metadata verified.
assets.notes: Original homepage film used as a full-screen background, with muted autoplay, 45-second loop and hidden provider controls.

screens.description: Electric hero, discovery paths, mission, experiences, media, giving, stories and photo journal.
113 total views share expressive typography, immersive covers and vibrant content surfaces.
